blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR) filed two criminal complaints before the Department of Justice (DOJ) on Oct. 14, 2026, involving combined assessed tax liabilities of ₱45.07 million for taxable years 2017 and 2018. The BIR filed one complaint against Interserve Management & Manpower Resources, Inc. (IMMRI) and its responsible corporate officers, and against a proprietress, for alleged “willful failure to pay taxes” in violation of the National Internal Revenue Code of 1997, as amended. “Our priority is to encourage voluntary compliance and help taxpayers meet their obligations.
